catalog-kits.brief: A neighborhood lending library search for seed trays shows no results. The patron can press a button to try the catalog's suggested search for planting kits and see the matching kit.

arguments.brief: A neighborhood lending library patron searches the catalog for “seed trays” and gets no results. Show a button that lets the patron try the catalog’s suggested search for “planting kits”. When the patron presses the button, run the suggested search and show the matching kit.

archive-first-slot.brief: A volunteer for the community archive opens their schedule and has nothing upcoming. Let them take the only offered Tuesday indexing slot and see it booked in that same view.

arguments.brief: Design the personal schedule view for a community archive volunteer. They have nothing upcoming and can book the only available shift, a Tuesday indexing slot. Give the volunteer one clear booking action and, once it succeeds, show the Tuesday shift as booked in their upcoming schedule on the same screen.

populated-catalog.brief: Show the community library's four current results for leaf rakes. Let patrons filter to available tools and sort by size.

arguments.brief: Show the community library's four current results for leaf rakes. Let patrons filter to available tools and sort by size.

library-metrics.brief: Design a staff analytics dashboard with zero-result search rates and the most common suggested searches, both compared with last week.

arguments.brief: Design a staff analytics dashboard with zero-result search rates and the most common suggested searches, both compared with last week.

staff-rota.brief: Build a supervisor's complete volunteer staff rota with assigned shifts, open slots, and a control to assign another volunteer.

arguments.brief: Design a scheduling dashboard for a volunteer supervisor. Show the complete staff rota with shift times, assigned volunteers, and open slots. The supervisor should be able to scan coverage, spot gaps, and assign another volunteer to a shift directly from the rota. Keep the schedule easy to scan and place assignment controls consistently across shifts.

previous-booking.brief: A volunteer already reserved one Wednesday Packing shift. Make the existing booking easy to find and let them view instructions for the day.

arguments.brief: A volunteer has already reserved one Wednesday Packing shift. Make that existing booking easy to find and give the volunteer a clear way to open the instructions for the day.
